name: sq
description: Sam Quigley's skills, bundled as one plugin: bibliographer (personal academic-paper collection), scientist (provenance-tracked experiment pipeline), research (literature reviews + grounded [lit:] claims), regulator (FDA regulatory-document library — guidance, Drugs@FDA approval packages, advisory-committee materials, reviewer dossiers), and gworkspace (read/act on Gmail, Calendar, and Drive across multiple Google accounts via the gog CLI). Invoked as /sq:bibliographer, /sq:scientist, /sq:research, /sq:regulator, /sq:gworkspace. Research skills built on libkit.
